outcome.technical: New shared/disclosure.css holds the disclosure arrow once: :where(.fdetails)>summary::after{content:"\25BE";content:"\25BE" / "";...} plus the [open] variant and the ::-webkit-details-marker hide. It is the first stylesheet part in ui/shared/. It is wired the way shared JS parts are: _ui_theme.REPORT_CSS_PARTS (first) and PANEL_CSS_PARTS (right after tokens-and-reset.css, which carries the panel's token placeholder), and _ui_theme_lints.UI_ASSETS. _output.ui_surface_sources already files shared/ under both surfaces by name, so there is no new assembly mechanism and no architecture change. The per-surface copies are removed from report-css/controls.css and panel-css/usage-tab.css (the panel's copy had no empty alternative, so it announced the triangle). Arrow choice: a text glyph with an empty alt rather than a border or background drawing, because forced-colours repaints text in the system colour instead of dropping it; ax5 measures that in Chromium (content still generated, color rgb(0, 0, 159) under forcedColors:active). The plain content declaration comes first because alt text for generated content is Baseline newly. Tests: ax4 and ax5 added to tools/check-report-interactive.mjs. da1 added to test__report_ui (shared rule present, exactly two >summary::after rules). cs8 and cs9 added to test__ui_theme (same shared CSS list in both cascades, read before surface parts). cs1 now finds shell.css as the first report-css part. cs2 and cs5 in test__ui_theme_lints now include shared CSS in each surface's declared set. Panel browser cases, in tools/capture-screenshots.mjs (driven by --check): pa1 in openUsageFilters() reads the Usage Filters summary's accessible name from the browser's AX tree on first sight, shut and then open, and fails on any Geometric Shapes glyph or an empty name. assertUsageHoverParity() (called from assertUsageWorks after the unfiltered compare, followed by a second unfiltered compare proving the tab is left as found) reads each control's computed style at rest and under a twice-moved pointer: ph1 #usage .fdetails>summary (border/background), ph2 .urow.pick:not(.on) (background), ph3 .ulegend b.pick (underline), then after clicking a ranked row to turn a filter on, ph4 .uchip (border) and ph5 the chip row's .lnk (underline); filters cleared with clearAll() at the end. Screenshots: a second full capture after adding the panel cases had the same UI digests (panel 8378f2e130b1, report 68b2058d9445) but its report filters.png showed the opened More-filters panel scrolled off-screen below the gate card, where the first capture's showed it in view - a report-leg flake this task did not touch. The first capture's set was restored (sc1/sc2 green, 292/292); the flake is a finding for the register, not fixed here. Rendered pages and screenshots are refreshed. check-report-interactive.mjs is extended. _report_html.py, test__report_html.py, shell.css and forced-colors.css are untouched and still correct: no selector they name moved. find-shared-candidates.mjs, the skills and guard-release.py are still correct: they name the directory, not its contents. _report_page.py was declared but not touched.
